refs_to_sec_case_settings.context: At unit poll size variant A completes the poll with every admissible unit neighbour of the incumbent, so that a failed unit poll certifies that no admissible neighbour improves it (Fig.~\ref{fig:search_generic}d). Each new poll point is evaluated by the coordination procedure of Algorithm~\ref{alg:operational_planning_degradation} and a point replaces the incumbent only if it improves $F$ by more than the two evaluations’ settling bars (the largest objective step over an evaluation’s last ten cycles) and the measured resolution $\sigma_Q$ of the recourse (Section~\ref{sec:case_settings}).

\paragraph{Resolution} The tolerance $\tau$ is set from the value resolution $\delta_R$ the study is to claim: $\tau = \delta_R \mathcal{V}/4$, with $\mathcal{V}$ a reference storage value, so that a ratio of two values --- four evaluations, each in error by at most $\tau$ --- is resolved to $\delta_R$. The rule bounds the stopping error of each evaluation at about $\tau$, not well inside it (Subsection~\ref{subsec:res_certification}); the values used in the case study are given in Section~\ref{sec:case_settings}.
The value of $\alpha$ is given in Section~\ref{sec:case_settings}.

Figure~\ref{fig:res_benchmark} and Table~\ref{tab:res_benchmark} compare coordinated operation with the passive and price-taker arrangements defined in Section~\ref{sec:case_settings}. All three arrangements are evaluated without shared storage, thereby separating the benefit of coordination from that of storage investment. The discounted operational cost is 653{,}873.7~k\euro{} under coordination, compared with 744{,}770.3~k\euro{} for the price-taker arrangement and 895{,}049.9~k\euro{} for the passive arrangement. The multi-scenario instance combines three market scenarios with three load and renewable-generation scenarios over five representative three-year blocks. The planning search again returned the plan without shared storage, $\boldsymbol{x}=\boldsymbol{0}$. As reported in Table~\ref{tab:res_multiscenario}, the reference unit provides an estimated discounted operational value of 236.7~k\euro{} against an investment cost of 318.0~k\euro{}. The resulting shortfall of 81.3~k\euro{} is 4.52 times the reported resolution of 18.0~k\euro{}, supporting the same economic conclusion as the single-scenario
